As a Man-Up Employee, you are the link between the order pickers, inventory, and the packing department within the outbound process. Once all products have been sorted from the containers, any remaining stock is collected into individual boxes and placed on pallets. These pallets are moved to the storage area, where you use a man-up truck, also known as a Very Narrow Aisle (VNA) truck, to place the individual boxes in the correct storage locations.
